title: Disney Mickey Mouse Lanyard Plush
categoryName: Clothing, Shoes & Accessories:Women:Women's Accessories:ID & Document Holders
descriptionText: The Disney Mickey Mouse Lanyard Plush is a colorful and fun accessory featuring the iconic character Mickey Mouse. Made of nylon and fabric, this one-size lanyard is perfect for holding ID cards or documents and is adorned with a novelty pattern. With a standard style and theme of cartoons & characters, this officially licensed Disney product is a must-have for fans of Mickey & Friends. Ideal for women who love Disney and want to add a touch of whimsy to their everyday look.
